cases.refreshed: Come join the fun every Wednesday for Baby Storytime & Stay and Play at the Los Altos Library! Non-walking babies (ages 0-1) and their caregivers can join a 20-minute program with catchy songs, silly rhymes, gentle movement, baby sign language, and short books. Stick around afterward for our popular "Stay & Play" session, where babies can explore fun, age-appropriate toys, and you can chat with other local parents and caregivers! It's the perfect weekly activity to boost early literacy, build community, and make some wonderful memories. Please feel free to bring a small blanket for your baby's comfort! When: Wednesdays, 1:00 PM – 2:00 PM; Where: Los Altos Library, Orchard Room. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

cases.refreshed: The group meets from 2:30 PM to 4:00 PM. Check with Cupertino Library for the meeting room. Cupertino Library's Knit-Alongs continue in 2026! All adult knitters and crocheters are welcome. No registration or sign-up required. We're always happy to meet someone new, so please feel free to join us. Meet new friends, start a new project, or finish an old one. Please note: This is mostly a social group for knitters and crocheters aged 18 and older. It is not intended to be a class for regular knitting and crochet instruction. We can supply some knitting and crochet supplies, but everyone is encouraged to bring their own knitting needles, crochet hooks and yarn. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
